mapper.select: SELECT tag_text as tagText, COUNT(*) AS count FROM hashtag GROUP BY (tag_text) ORDER BY COUNT desc LIMIT 4

SELECT user_id AS userId, user_chat AS userChat, ai_chat AS aiChat, ch.create_at AS createAt, GROUP_CONCAT(h.tag_text ORDER BY h.tag_text SEPARATOR ',') AS tags FROM chat_history ch LEFT OUTER JOIN hashtag h ON ch.no = h.no WHERE h.tag_text = #{tag} GROUP BY ch.user_id, ch.user_chat, ch.ai_chat, ch.create_at ORDER BY ch.create_at DESC
